name: progress
title: Progress
description: A progress bar that fills along a scripted value: a fast start, a stall, then a finish.
useWhen: Showing a loading, upload or completion bar animating to a target value.
Visualizing progression through a flow as a single continuous bar.
You need a labelled percentage readout next to the fill.
avoidWhen: The state is binary (done or not): use switch.
You need numbered step-by-step progress: use stepper.
You need a range input the user drags: use slider.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Show label
variables.description: Show the percentage next to the bar.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the control sits over your own scene.
